interpretation.summary: On a new balanced source-roster holdout, FALSUM exactly separates affected from fixed boundaries and removes 12 citation-only false positives, while tying rather than beating the independently implemented competent interval baseline.

limits: The selected source records are independent public advisory facts, not human semantic AppSec gold.
Synthetic boundary targets are source-covered version probes, not evidence that a deployment is exploitable.
The result demonstrates applicability discrimination, not general vulnerability recall or a network ranking change.
